We keep refining how we work, and you are expected to improve the processes you own. We hire on what you have built and run yourself, and growth works the same way. description: Description ﻿Who We Are ﻿ WeSki 's vision is to make it easy for skiers across the globe to book and enjoy their ideal ski trip at the best possible price. As the ultimate ski trip booking platform, WeSki enables everyone to design and book their ideal adventure in just a few clicks, quickly, seamlessly, and affordably. In an $100 billion industry that has remained largely traditional, this opens up a massive opportunity to redefine ski trips for modern consumers. WeSki 's technology compares millions of combinations of flights, accommodation, transfers, passes, gear, and lessons instantly, saving hours of planning. Each trip is fully customisable, giving customers the flexibility of building it themselves, but with the expert protection and support of a holiday provider. With all trip components automatically linked, customers can relax and enjoy their holiday knowing that all the logistics are taken care of, alongside 24/7 customer service whilst they're away. WeSki is an innovative, passionate, and fast-moving company. We partner with over 300 ski resorts (and counting) across 20 countries and have already sold over 180,000 ski holiday packages to skiers worldwide. We are in a rapid growth mode whilst maintaining profitability, making our business and product opportunities (and challenges) all the more exciting. Role Overview ﻿ We are building a dedicated sales function at WeSki , and we are looking for the person to lead it. Many of our customers are happy to plan and book independently through our platform. Others want to talk to someone who genuinely knows the resorts, understands what makes a family ski holiday work, and can help them make confident decisions. This role exists to serve that second group properly. The profile we are looking for is specific: an excellent travel professional who is also a genuine skiing expert . You need to bring both to the table, because our customers are trusting us with the trip they save up for all year, and that trust is built in the first few minutes of a conversation. This is a founding leadership position. You will design the sales process end to end, define how success is measured, build and coach the team, and own the results. In the first season you will also sell personally: this is a hands-on role, not a purely managerial one. As the function proves itself, you will grow the team and hire into it. The role reports into Customer Experience and works closely with Growth, Operations and Product. It is fully remote, with a strong focus on the UK and European markets. A deep understanding of the UK consumer travel market is essential. Key Responsibilities: ﻿ Build the function. Design the sales process from first contact through to a booked holiday, including how enquiries are prioritised, how conversations are managed, and how a booking is handed over to our operations team. Set the strategy. Define how we sell, to whom, and through which channels, and adapt it as the market and our product evolve.

Dit gaat verder dan de vak inhoud omdat we geloven in de complete mensontwikkeling; De ruimte om zowel vanuit huis, ons kantoor of vanuit het kantoor van onze opdrachtgever te werken. title: Society College Werkstudent
description: Ben je HBO of WO student en wil je naast je studie relevante werkervaring opdoen én een uniek vormingsprogramma doorlopen? Ben je maatschappelijk betrokken en wil je écht impact maken? Wil je naast het inzetten van jouw kennis en vaardigheden in een opdracht, ook zogenaamde ‘life skills’ opdoen? Dan is het werkstudentprogramma bij Society College misschien iets voor jou! In een opdracht voor minimaal 16 uur per week werk je bij een publieke of private organisatie, waar je kennis gaat maken met verschillende organisaties en jouw kennis, ervaring en talenten in kunt zetten. Elke twaalf maanden wissel je van werkplek, zodat je verschillende omgevingen ontdekt en beter leert wat bij je past. Zo bouw je een brede ervaring op en bereid je je optimaal voor op je toekomst. Je werkt mee in een bestaand, lopend team of je pakt een specifiek project op. Dit hangt af van het type organisatie en de uitdagingen die er liggen. Een aantal praktijkvoorbeelden zijn; onderdeel worden van een innovatie team op het gebied van duurzaamheid, meewerken in de dagelijkse praktijk van een team van analisten bij een bank of een onderzoekproject binnen een overheidsorganisatie. De gemeenschappelijke delers op onze werkplekken zijn: Ontwikkeling staat voorop, we dagen je uit om uit je comfort zone te stappen Je steekt je handen uit de mouwen om van theorie naar actie over te gaan Je draagt bij aan iets groters dan jezelf Je krijgt intensieve begeleiding vanuit een werkplekbegeleider en vanuit onze talentcoach Je bouwt een waardevol netwerk op voor de toekomst Naast het opdoen van werkervaring, neem je deel aan ons unieke vormingsprogramma. Het programma bestaat uit evenementen, vrijwilligersactiviteiten, workshops en persoonlijke coaching. Wij begeleiden je op een manier die bij jou past, want jouw ontwikkeling staat centraal. Dat betekent dat we actieve deelname aan ons vormingsprogramma minstens net zo belangrijk vinden als jouw inzet op je werkplek. Het doel van ons vormingsprogramma is ‘leren wat je op school niet leert’. Wat kun je van het vormingsprogramma verwachten? Je gaat ontdekken wat jouw unieke talenten zijn, hoe je deze verder kunt ontwikkelen en inzetten om impact te maken. Je gaat jouw talenten hands-on inzetten om impact te maken. Je gaat groeien in zelfvertrouwen en veerkracht, door uit je comfort zone te stappen. Je krijgt trainingen en coaching op het gebied van persoonlijke ontwikkeling onder begeleiding van professionals. Je wordt onderdeel van de SC-community Je krijgt de kans om jouw leiderschap te ontwikkelen Je gaat deelnemen aan de Burgerreserve opleiding (link) waarin je skills for life leert Je krijgt de kans om te werken op unieke werkplekken en daarmee te bouwen aan jouw CV. Jij bouwt mee aan Society College Bij Society College Tech ben je niet alleen werkstudent, je bent vooral ook onderdeel van ons, met elkaar vormen wij Society College . Wij hebben jou hard nodig en hopen dat je mee wilt denken over de groei en ontwikkeling van Society Colleg

title: Freelance Pitch Form
description: ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest. While the vast majority of ProPublica ’s work comes from our staff, we occasionally consider supporting ambitious accountability stories or projects from independent journalists whose ideas align with the mission of our organization. Here’s what journalists submitting proposals should know. We’re open to investigations that are revelatory or substantially advance what is known on a subject of importance. The investigation should have the potential to trigger needed reforms by identifying a problem, who’s responsible and what should change. It should also clearly show harm. The investigation can be rooted in a place or focus on a person, but it should illuminate an issue of broader relevance. The best proposals have a clear hypothesis, typically based on significant reporting: They don’t wonder whether something bad is happening, they know it. Please include not only a general description of the topic, but also a sense of the anecdotes/data/documents you have gathered, what you expect to find and possible accountability stories you want to tell. In addition, applicants should detail, as much as is possible at the outset, what an investigation will require: data work, travel, obtaining public records. It’s also important for us to know what data, documents and/or source relationships the reporter already has. Finally, we’d like to hear a bit about why you are particularly suited to do this investigation. We will begin reviewing applications as we receive them, and aim to notify candidates regarding your proposals within two weeks of submission. Questions? Send an email to . No phone calls, please. For those proposals we accept, we pay competitive freelance rates, including reporting expenses. Freelancers are independent contractors and will not be treated by ProPublica as employees for any purpose. Independent contractors are responsible for paying any required taxes on any compensation received and for understanding the applicable tax laws. We will begin reviewing applications as we receive them, and aim to notify candidates regarding your proposals within two weeks of submission. We know there are great candidates who may not fit into what we’ve described above or who have important skills we haven’t thought of. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself. We are dedicated to improving our newsroom, in part by better reflecting the people we cover. (Here is a breakdown of our staff.) We are committed to diversity and building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and ages. And we are taking steps to meet that commitment. We especially encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply, including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ people and people with disabilities. We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decision

title: Content Creator & Community Lead
description: This is a remote position. Own The Space (OTS) is a campaign accelerator and sister organisation of Led By Donkeys. We build campaign teams around projects we believe can have a positive impact in the world, then develop and scale them. Our leadership team has decades of experience incubating and growing campaigns and organisations. Project Dear Britain Something is broken in the story we're being told about Britain. The people who want to divide us, who thrive on grievance, resentment and nostalgia for a country that never really existed, have been dominating the conversation. Dear Britain is here to change that. Not with anger, but with something more powerful: a fuller, funnier, more honest story about the country we actually live in. We work with creators, community organisations and cultural partners to tell it, and we get it into the places Britain actually talks: the family group chat, the five-a-side group, the street WhatsApp. We're looking for a social media expert who moves fast, knows what travels, and wants to run the group chats Britain actually reads. This is not a traditional comms role. About the role You'll work on our social output across platforms. Our WhatsApp communities are live. Our WhatsApp Channel is next. You'll work on both. Day to day, you'll work a bit like a DJ: reading the room, then finding, cutting and mixing the right content into the right group at the right moment. A clip that flies in one community will die in another. You'll know the difference. You'll also work with creators on angles and timing, and test AI tools that help us make more, faster. You'll work with video editors to turn moments into fast-turnaround socials, cut in CapCut and out the same day on TikTok, Instagram and Facebook. We're a small team, so you'll also jump into whatever needs doing. What success looks like Communities that feel alive, timely and worth staying in A WhatsApp Channel built from zero into something with genuine reach Sharp, fast socials that land across platforms A steady flow of insight back to the team on what's travelling and why What you'll do WhatsApp Manage WhatsApp communities, deciding what goes where, and when Lead the launch and growth of the Dear Britain WhatsApp Channel Track what travels and what doesn't, and adjust Fast-turnaround content Spot moments early and turn them into socials the same day Brief and work alongside video editors on quick CapCut edits for TikTok, Instagram and Facebook Work with creators on content, angles and timing Cut and repurpose content so one idea works everywhere, from Reels to the family group chat Jumping in Experiment with AI tools to make and adapt content faster Support whatever's next, from partner campaigns and live events to creator projects Requirements Who you are You don't need a background in non-profits to apply. title: Photonic Layout Engineer
description: HyperLight is at the forefront of the commercialization of thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) integrated photonics — a material and process technology that is enabling high-performance, scalable optical components across AI/datacom infrastructure, hyperscale computing, quantum computing, sensing, and beyond. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading venture capital, we’ve built a team and a platform focused on real-world mass deployment of TFLN photonics technology. At the core of our work is the TFLN Chiplet™ platform: a modular architecture designed for scalability, manufacturability, and integration into complex systems. We partner with our customers and suppliers from concept and prototyping through mass production. We believe in integrity, innovation, collaboration, and pragmatic solutions, and we take pride in tackling hard problems with curiosity, humility, and a deep sense of care for one another. We’re hiring a Senior Photonic Layout Engineer to join our layout team and turn TFLN device and circuit designs into manufacturable, tapeout-ready masks. Your layouts will go straight to the fab and into products that ship to customers. You’ll collaborate with device designers, process engineers, and our test team to design the layout of product chips and test structures. Our layout tools are code-driven and most of your time will be spent writing software: we automate everything we can by building parametric cells and full-chip layouts in Python with GDSFactory and other script-driven layout tools. TFLN and electro-optic experience are not required – we have deep in-house expertise and will teach you. Experienced layout engineers from silicon photonics, III-V, MEMS, or electronic IC backgrounds are all welcome. Why this role: Fast iteration: We tape out frequently, so you’ll see your work fabricated and tested on a cadence most photonics companies can’t match. Ownership: You’ll shape the layout libraries, automation, and best practices our whole design team builds on. An emerging platform: TFLN is one of the most exciting technologies in integrated photonics, and you’ll be building it at the commercial frontier. Software-first culture: We treat layout like code, with version control, review, and automation, not hours of manual polygon-pushing. As part of your responsibilities, you will: Lay out integrated photonic devices, circuits, and full masks, including transmitter PICs, waveguides, couplers, EO modulators, and test structures. Build and maintain parametric cells, routing, and layout automation tools using tools like Python (GDSFactory, Klayout) and Cadence Virtuoso. Run DRC and other verification checks, triage violations, and work with the foundry on rule interpretation and waivers. Prepare and deliver tapeouts: floor planning, mask assembly, design reviews, and on-time GDS handoff. Help shape our layout libraries, design rules, and best practices, and keep the shared codebase clean and reviewable. Requirements B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Electric

Familiarity with European Portuguese vocabulary, idioms, slang, and spelling conventions, including Arabic, French, and English influences. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify subtle linguistic differences. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an emphasis on clarity, accuracy, and collaboration. Experience in audio annotation or ASR transcript editing is an advantage but not required. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: What success looks like in this role: Position Summary The Linux Patching Engineer is responsible for patching activities across enterprise Linux environments, particularly Red Hat Enterprise Linux, including planning, testing, scheduling, deployment, validation, compliance reporting, exception management, and remediation. The engineer ensures operating system, kernel, and core package patches are deployed consistently, safely, and in line with security, operational, and customer requirements, improving audit readiness and reducing exposure to known vulnerabilities. Manage patch content in Red Hat Satellite or an equivalent platform (content views, lifecycle environments, repository snapshots) to give each environment a tested, consistent baseline. Review errata, dependencies, and known issues; coordinate testing across development, test, staging, disaster recovery, and production, accounting for application compatibility, third-party agents and kernel modules, and high-availability clusters such as Pacemaker. Prepare implementation, validation, communication, and backout plans; maintain change records (risk assessments, approvals, test evidence, affected systems); and confirm backup and recovery readiness before deployment. Lead patch readiness and go/no-go reviews; coordinate deployments and reboot sequencing in approved windows, apply kernel live patches where supported, and verify systems, applications, services, and clusters afterward. Troubleshoot package conflicts, repository errors, failed kernel updates, and post-patch boot or service issues; coordinate rollback or recovery, escalate service-impacting failures, and apply lessons learned to future cycles. Work with the Linux Vulnerability Engineer to turn vulnerability findings into patching plans; reconcile scanner results, Satellite errata status, deployment records, and asset inventories to close coverage gaps and drive failed, overdue, or noncompliant systems to closure.
